note: Regional park in the jack pines of the Canwood Regional Forest, 3 km from the village of Canwood, beside its 9-hole grass-green golf course. The sites sit in the park's core near camp kitchens, the shower house and ball diamonds; firewood is free. Seasonal sites are available on request. --Claude
summary: Keep (local). SRP page: 30/50 A sites with water at every site, showers, flush toilets, dump; season May 1 - Sep 30; reservations by phone (email off-season), so platform phone. Fees only as 2025 (C$27 E&W, C$17 non-electric, entry C$10/day). Site count unsourced. PIN MOVE ~640 m: stored point is the SRP GPS on the highway at the park's north edge -> 53.3645,-106.5425 (camping area; Google's place point agrees). Not waterfront kept (golf-course irrigation pond only). Google 4.6 (44).
